summary.en: Up to ₹2 lakh over the degree for 5,000 first-year, regular full-time undergraduate students of any stream, with 60%+ in 12th and household income up to ₹15 lakh. Merit-cum-means: an online application plus a mandatory online aptitude test. No fee at any stage.
summary.mr: कोणत्याही शाखेतील पदवीच्या पहिल्या वर्षाच्या, नियमित पूर्णवेळ ५,००० विद्यार्थ्यांना पदवीच्या काळात ₹२ लाखांपर्यंत शिष्यवृत्ती. अटी: १२वीत किमान ६०% आणि कुटुंबाचे उत्पन्न ₹१५ लाखांपर्यंत. ऑनलाइन अर्ज + अनिवार्य ऑनलाइन ॲप्टिट्यूड टेस्ट. कोणतेही शुल्क नाही.
summary.hi: किसी भी स्ट्रीम के ग्रेजुएशन के पहले साल के, रेगुलर फुल-टाइम 5,000 छात्रों को डिग्री के दौरान ₹2 लाख तक की स्कॉलरशिप। शर्तें: 12वीं में कम से कम 60% और परिवार की आय ₹15 लाख तक। ऑनलाइन आवेदन + अनिवार्य ऑनलाइन एप्टीट्यूड टेस्ट। कोई फीस नहीं।

notes: Amount: up to Rs. 2 lakh during the undergraduate course; 5,000 scholarships a year (100 more are postgraduate, a separate scheme). Merit-cum-means selection. No fee at any stage of the application (media release, guidance document).
Income: household income = parents' income only; at most Rs. 15 lakh a year, and preference goes to household income below Rs. 2.5 lakh (FAQ).

Not eligible (FAQ): second year or above (started in 2025-26 or earlier); online, distance, remote or other non-regular mode; a two-year or six-year degree; skipping the aptitude test, cheating in it, or attempting it more than once; a degree outside India.

Also from the FAQ: no age limit; 12th passed abroad is fine; a diploma after 10th without 12th is not enough (12th with 60% is needed); CA/CS students qualify only if also in the first year of a regular full-time degree (e.g. B.Com., BBA, B.Sc.) and enter that degree in the form; any NAAC-accredited or UGC-recognised institution in India.

How to apply: register on scholarships.reliancefoundation.org, open the link in the activation email, log in to the application portal with the registered mobile number and the OTP sent to it (the student types the OTP themselves), fill the form (about 30 minutes, can be saved and finished later), upload the documents (DigiLocker recommended), submit, then add bank account and PAN details and take the aptitude test in the assigned slot.

Form tips (guidance document): name exactly as on Aadhaar; marks exactly as on the marksheets; course name as in admission records; use a personal email (Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook), not an institute email; only one application per student; it cannot be edited after final submission (one correction request by email is allowed); no deadline extensions.
Application is complete only after BOTH the submitted form and the aptitude test. Confirmation: an email plus an application number on screen; the application can be downloaded as a ZIP.

Aptitude test: online multiple-choice, Class-12 level, three parts: Verbal Ability, Analytical & Logical Ability, Numerical Ability. A practice test is available first. Camera and microphone on, full-screen, one sitting, alone, stable internet, quiet well-lit room; no other tabs.

Selection: aptitude test performance + the academic and personal information in the application, then document verification of shortlisted applicants, then final selection. Results by 28 December 2026.
Timeline 2026-27: applications opened 15 August 2026; close 5 October 2026 (11:59 PM IST); aptitude test closes 18 October 2026; results 28 December 2026.
